name: Cubing-on-Hudson PM 2024

venue.name: James V. Harmon Community Center
venue.details: The event is being held in conjunction with Hastings Recreation Department. Enter via the front door and the room is to your left.

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
